verdict.rationale: Martin is documented as a personal AI assistant tied to one user's calendar, inbox, Slack, to-dos and notes. Assistants of this kind could plausibly offer team workspaces, so the axis applies. However, no evidence shows organization workspaces, member management, role permissions, or admin-set data policies. Community privacy concerns describe user worries, not admin controls.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can manage members, permissions, and data policies for my organization's workspace
